description: The text of a TypeScript file listing an application's flag keys, so a misspelled key is a type error and editors autocomplete keys. Write the returned text to the path exactly as it is, and commit it. Only for TypeScript projects using @flagbearer/web (React and browser apps), @flagbearer/node or @flagbearer/react-native. Call it when setting up flags in such a project, and again after creating a flag.
name: generate_flag_types
title: Generate typed flag keys
